lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

def DeltaZero (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : Prop := Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ

attribute [simp] Hierarchy.verum Hierarchy.falsum Hierarchy.rel Hierarchy.nrel

namespace Hierarchy

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma or_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋎ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case or =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,

  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ := ⟨zero_eq_alt, zero_eq_alt⟩

lemma zero_iff {Γ Γ'} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ' 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> rcases Γ' <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma zero_iff_delta_zero {Γ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ DeltaZero φ := by
  simp[DeltaZero, pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]; apply zero_iff

@[simp] lemma alt_zero_iff_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

lemma neg {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt s (∼φ) := by
  intro h; induction h <;> try simp[*]
  case bex pos _ ih => exact ball pos ih
  case ball pos _ ih => exact bex pos ih
  case ex ih => exact all ih
  case all ih => exact ex ih
  case sigma ih => exact pi ih
  case pi ih => exact sigma ih
  case dummy_pi ih => exact dummy_sigma ih
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact dummy_pi ih

@[simp] lemma neg_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (∼φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ :=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using neg h, fun h => by simpa using neg h⟩

@[simp] lemma imp_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ➝ ψ) ↔ (Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ) := by simp[Semiformula.imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma ball_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} (ht : t.Positive) :

  ⟨by generalize hq : (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hq
      case ball φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case all hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case pi s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl

        rcases hq with rfl

        exact hp.accum _,

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Arith.Hierarchy.and_iff
C0_dependencies.content:
@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Arith.Hierarchy.zero_eq_alt
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

informal_statement: In the context of a given structure $Γ$ and a formula $φ$, applying a bounded quantifier or operation to $φ$ does not alter its membership within the hierarchy defined by $Γ$ and $s$. Specifically, the bounded version of $φ$ within the hierarchy is equivalent to the original $φ$ in terms of its placement within the hierarchy.
informal_proof:
Given the lemma, which is a straightforward simplification, we can reason as follows:

1. The hierarchy $Γ s$ defines a collection of formulas based on the structure $Γ$ and the parameter $s$.
2. Applying the operation $\texttt{ballLTSucc}\ t$ to a formula $φ$ results in a bounded version of $φ$, where the quantifiers are limited by the successor of $t$.
3. The equivalence stated in the lemma asserts that whether or not a formula belongs to the hierarchy $Γ s$ is unaffected by this bounding operation.
4. This is because the bounding operation, while modifying the formula, maintains its fundamental structure and properties within the defined hierarchy.
5. Therefore, $φ.ballLTSucc\ t$ and $φ$ are indistinguishable in terms of their membership within the hierarchy $Γ s$.
6. Hence, the bounded formula does not change the membership status relative to the hierarchy.

This completes the informal proof of the stated lemma.

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} [L.LT]

namespace Arith

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

C0_dependencies.content:
lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Arith.Hierarchy.accum
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma

  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} [L.LT]

namespace Arith

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

def DeltaZero (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : Prop := Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ

attribute [simp] Hierarchy.verum Hierarchy.falsum Hierarchy.rel Hierarchy.nrel

namespace Hierarchy

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma or_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋎ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case or =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
      by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.or hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ := ⟨zero_eq_alt, zero_eq_alt⟩

lemma zero_iff {Γ Γ'} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ' 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> rcases Γ' <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma zero_iff_delta_zero {Γ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ DeltaZero φ := by
  simp[DeltaZero, pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]; apply zero_iff

@[simp] lemma alt_zero_iff_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex

    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

  case ball pos _ ih => exact bex pos ih
  case ex ih => exact all ih
  case all ih => exact ex ih
  case sigma ih => exact pi ih
  case pi ih => exact sigma ih

  case dummy_sigma ih => exact dummy_pi ih

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} [L.LT]

namespace Arith

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

def DeltaZero (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : Prop := Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ

attribute [simp] Hierarchy.verum Hierarchy.falsum Hierarchy.rel Hierarchy.nrel

namespace Hierarchy

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma or_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋎ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case or =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
      by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.or hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ := ⟨zero_eq_alt, zero_eq_alt⟩

lemma zero_iff {Γ Γ'} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ' 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> rcases Γ' <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma zero_iff_delta_zero {Γ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ DeltaZero φ := by
  simp[DeltaZero, pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]; apply zero_iff

@[simp] lemma alt_zero_iff_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

section

variable {L : Language}

@[simp] lemma equal [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t = !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq]

@[simp] lemma lt [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t < !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq]

@[simp] lemma le [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t ≤ !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq,
    Semiformula.Operator.LE.sentence_eq]

end

lemma neg {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt s (∼φ) := by
  intro h; induction h <;> try simp[*]
  case bex pos _ ih => exact ball pos ih
  case ball pos _ ih => exact bex pos ih
  case ex ih => exact all ih
  case all ih => exact ex ih
  case sigma ih => exact pi ih
  case pi ih => exact sigma ih
  case dummy_pi ih => exact dummy_sigma ih
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact dummy_pi ih

@[simp] lemma neg_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (∼φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ :=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using neg h, fun h => by simpa using neg h⟩

@[simp] lemma imp_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ➝ ψ) ↔ (Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ) := by simp[Semiformula.imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma ball_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} (ht : t.Positive) :
    Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ :=
  ⟨by generalize hq : (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hq
      case ball φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case all hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case pi s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _
      case dummy_sigma hp _ =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,
   by intro hp; exact hp.ball ht⟩

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

C0_dependencies.content:
lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

C0_dependencies.content:
lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} [L.LT]

namespace Arith

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

def DeltaZero (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : Prop := Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ

attribute [simp] Hierarchy.verum Hierarchy.falsum Hierarchy.rel Hierarchy.nrel

namespace Hierarchy

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma or_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋎ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case or =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
      by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.or hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ := ⟨zero_eq_alt, zero_eq_alt⟩

lemma zero_iff {Γ Γ'} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ' 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> rcases Γ' <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma zero_iff_delta_zero {Γ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ DeltaZero φ := by
  simp[DeltaZero, pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]; apply zero_iff

@[simp] lemma alt_zero_iff_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq]

    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq]

lemma neg {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt s (∼φ) := by
  intro h; induction h <;> try simp[*]
  case bex pos _ ih => exact ball pos ih
  case ball pos _ ih => exact bex pos ih
  case ex ih => exact all ih
  case all ih => exact ex ih
  case sigma ih => exact pi ih
  case pi ih => exact sigma ih
  case dummy_pi ih => exact dummy_sigma ih
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact dummy_pi ih

@[simp] lemma neg_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (∼φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ :=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using neg h, fun h => by simpa using neg h⟩

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Arith.Hierarchy.and_iff
C0_dependencies.content:
@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Arith.Hierarchy.zero_eq_alt
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

Specifically, the hierarchy defined by \( Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ) \) is equivalent to \( Hierarchy Γ s φ \). This holds because the condition \( x < !!t \) encompasses all relevant variables considered in the expression.
informal_proof:
To establish the equivalence between \( Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ) \) and \( Hierarchy Γ s φ \), we analyze the impact of restricting the existential quantifier to the condition \( x < !!t \). 

1. **Understanding the Role of \( x < !!t \)**: The condition \( x < !!t \) serves as a limitation on the variables \( x \) considered within the scope of the existential quantifier. This restriction does not alter the fundamental relationship or the context defined by \( φ \), as \( x \) is inherently bound within the expression \( !!t \).

2. **Case Analysis on Quantifiers**:
   - **Existential Quantifier (bex)**: When dealing with \( ∃x (x < !!t \land φ) \), the restriction \( x < !!t \) inherently includes all \( x \) that satisfy \( φ \), proving the equivalence.
   - **Universal Quantifier (ex)**: Similarly, for \( \forall x < !!t (φ) \), the condition ensures that \( x \) remains within the intended domain, preserving the truth value without affecting the hierarchy.
   - **Sigma Types (sigma)**: For more complex types defined with \( \Sigma \), the restriction \( x < !!t \) ensures that the types remain consistent across the quantifier, maintaining the hierarchy's integrity.
   - **Dummy Pi Type (dummy_pi)**: This case deals with product types where \( x < !!t \) does not affect the product's structure, hence equivalence is straightforward.

3. **Inductive Step and Conclusion**: By induction on the structure of \( H \), each case confirms that the restriction \( x < !!t \) does not disrupt the equivalence between the bounded and unbounded existential quantifiers. This inductive proof solidifies the equivalence across all possible configurations of \( Γ \), \( s \), and \( t \).

Thus, the hierarchy remains unaffected by the restriction \( x < !!t \), and the equivalence holds universally under these conditions.

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} [L.LT]

namespace Arith

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

def DeltaZero (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : Prop := Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ

attribute [simp] Hierarchy.verum Hierarchy.falsum Hierarchy.rel Hierarchy.nrel

namespace Hierarchy

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma or_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋎ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case or =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
      by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.or hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ := ⟨zero_eq_alt, zero_eq_alt⟩

lemma zero_iff {Γ Γ'} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ' 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> rcases Γ' <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma zero_iff_delta_zero {Γ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ DeltaZero φ := by

@[simp] lemma alt_zero_iff_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v

  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex

  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ

    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all

    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _

lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} [L.LT]

namespace Arith

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

def DeltaZero (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : Prop := Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ

attribute [simp] Hierarchy.verum Hierarchy.falsum Hierarchy.rel Hierarchy.nrel

namespace Hierarchy

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma or_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋎ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case or =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
      by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.or hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ := ⟨zero_eq_alt, zero_eq_alt⟩

lemma zero_iff {Γ Γ'} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ' 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> rcases Γ' <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma zero_iff_delta_zero {Γ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ DeltaZero φ := by
  simp[DeltaZero, pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]; apply zero_iff

@[simp] lemma alt_zero_iff_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)

  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

rag.content:
@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : ∀ n, Semiformula L ξ n → Sort w}
  (hverum  : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊤)
  (hfalsum : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊥)
  (hrel    : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (rel r v))
  (hnrel   : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (nrel r v))
  (hand    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋎ ψ))
  (hall    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∀' φ))
  (hex     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ
  | _, verum    => hverum
  | _, falsum   => hfalsum
  | _, rel r v  => hrel r v
  | _, nrel r v => hnrel r v
  | _, and φ ψ  => hand φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, or φ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, all φ    => hall φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)
  | _, ex φ     => hex φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

def DeltaZero (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : Prop := Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ

attribute [simp] Hierarchy.verum Hierarchy.falsum Hierarchy.rel Hierarchy.nrel

namespace Hierarchy

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma or_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋎ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case or =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
      by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.or hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ := ⟨zero_eq_alt, zero_eq_alt⟩

lemma zero_iff {Γ Γ'} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ' 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> rcases Γ' <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma zero_iff_delta_zero {Γ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ DeltaZero φ := by
  simp[DeltaZero, pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]; apply zero_iff

@[simp] lemma alt_zero_iff_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

section

variable {L : Language}

@[simp] lemma equal [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t = !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq]

@[simp] lemma lt [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t < !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq]

@[simp] lemma le [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t ≤ !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq,
    Semiformula.Operator.LE.sentence_eq]

end

lemma neg {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt s (∼φ) := by
  exact?

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

C0_dependencies.content:
lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Arith.Hierarchy.accum
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} [L.LT]

namespace Arith

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

def DeltaZero (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : Prop := Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ

attribute [simp] Hierarchy.verum Hierarchy.falsum Hierarchy.rel Hierarchy.nrel

namespace Hierarchy

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma or_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋎ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case or =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
      by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.or hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ := ⟨zero_eq_alt, zero_eq_alt⟩

lemma zero_iff {Γ Γ'} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ' 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> rcases Γ' <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma zero_iff_delta_zero {Γ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ DeltaZero φ := by
  simp[DeltaZero, pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]; apply zero_iff

@[simp] lemma alt_zero_iff_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)

  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ := ⟨zero_eq_alt, zero_eq_alt⟩

lemma zero_iff {Γ Γ'} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ' 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> rcases Γ' <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma zero_iff_delta_zero {Γ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ DeltaZero φ := by
  simp[DeltaZero, pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]; apply zero_iff

@[simp] lemma alt_zero_iff_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Arith.Hierarchy.and_iff
C0_dependencies.content:
@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Arith.Hierarchy.conj_iff
C0_dependencies.content:
@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],

  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} [L.LT]

namespace Arith

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic
